answer: Proof of Useful Work provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to compute a resource-intensive kernel function to validate identity. Like a falcon tracking prey, the network monitors computational expenditure, ensuring each identity represents sunk energy costs. A sparrow-sized micro-transaction fee acts as a deterrent, forcing attackers to fund every malicious node. This economic barrier makes scaling fake identities prohibitively expensive, preserving the integrity of the decentralized registry.
